purpose: Define the review-only implementation record required before any candidate atomic predictive-v1 operator can be promoted into accepted delta_uet_or_ci provenance.

required_checks.requirement: The review record points to the current target module and required entrypoint.
The selected operator class matches the current class-selection review.
A runtime source hash can be computed for the target module used in review.
At least one locked review-only parameter set exists for the selected class.
The record still states that the operator is not accepted, so implementation identity cannot be confused with accepted provenance.

blocked_claims: a review-only implementation record means an accepted operator exists
module identity and source hash alone satisfy accepted operator provenance
review-only parameter sets may be cited as accepted operator output
claim_boundary: This manifest defines a review-only implementation record. It does not accept or validate delta_uet_or_ci.
